jobs.title: Director and Practice Lead, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital agency and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across: Digital Product Strategy & Innovation, Digital Marketing Services, Web & Mobile App Development, Data & AI, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Technology Modernization.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

Our Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will operate remotely in Canada OR be based out of either our Toronto, ON or Vancouver, BC office locations.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital's Data, AI & Cloud (DAIC) practice is the multidisciplinary engine behind enterprise AI, blending boutique innovation with the breadth of a global services portfolio to help organizations architect, scale, and secure their transformations. Spanning our full family of specialized capabilities, the DAIC practice delivers end-to-end solutions across AI Advisory, AI Solutions, Data & AI Platforms, and Cloud Transformation.

As a premier Google Cloud partner, our Cloud practice is at the forefront of helping enterprises adopt and scale on Google Cloud infrastructure: delivering complex engineering, deployment, and migration programs for some of the largest organizations in Canada and beyond.

The Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will define and own the Data Engineering Practice along with its market positioning, P&L, talent, and the quality of work we deliver for clients. This role is for someone who has led data and AI practices before, understands how to turn messy enterprise data estates into strategic assets, and earns trust with C-suite executives through genuine expertise. You will shape how we help clients move from data ambition to durable, AI-ready infrastructure.

This Role Will Have Four Core Anchor Responsibilities

Strategy: Set the practice vision and align Data & AI capabilities to where enterprise demand is heading.
P&L: Own revenue targets, margin, and growth while being accountable for the practice's full commercial performance.
Talent & Culture: Build a practice where data-driven thinking, innovation, and engineering rigour are the baseline.
Client Impact: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise CxOs navigating data strategy, AI adoption, and governance.

Responsibilities

Define the multi-year vision for the Data Engineering Practice, ensuring our technical capabilities are ahead of the curve for enterprise demand for Data & AI transformation.
Own the full P&L, including pipeline, pricing, delivery margin, and revenue growth, while reporting directly to executive leadership with clear commercial accountability.
Build and sustain senior relationships with Google Cloud partner teams and client executives to generate meaningful deal flow and expand strategic accounts.
Lead the practice's position on ethical AI and data democratisation while making principled, evidence-based bets on where advanced analytics and AI are creating real enterprise value.
Drive investment in reusable IP, data accelerators, and delivery assets that improve consistency, reduce time-to-value, and protect margins at scale.
Serve as a strategic advisor to client C-suite executives, helping them define data strategy, navigate AI adoption, and build the organisational capabilities to sustain it.
Set the standard for engineering and analytical excellence across the practice by hiring well, developing talent deliberately, and building teams that clients trust and return to.

Competencies

12+ years in data or AI consulting, including at least 3–5 years in a practice leadership or executive role, not just senior delivery or individual contribution.
Proven P&L ownership: Direct experience managing revenue, margin, and growth targets in a consulting or professional services context.
Data and AI ecosystem depth: Strong command of modern data architecture, AI, and ML trends, cloud-native data platforms, and enterprise data governance.
Executive communication: Able to advise, challenge, and build lasting trust with C-suite stakeholders on complex, ambiguous problems, not just present to them.
Business Development track record: Experience generating pipeline and closing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, not just managing delivery once work is sold.
Talent leadership: Has hired, grown, and retained senior data engineering and consulting talent in a practice or delivery organisation.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

Compensation Range: CA$211K - CA$302K

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Analytics & Prospecting
jobs.description:
About UJA Federation of Greater Toronto

At UJA Federation of Greater Toronto, our vision is to lead the most vibrant Jewish community in North America - a community characterized by its diversity, unity, compassion, generosity and commitment to Jewish values. Together with our philanthropic, volunteer and professional leadership, we’re changing lives.
As one of North America’s leading Jewish non-profits, UJA Federation of Greater Toronto works to preserve and strengthen the quality of Jewish life in Greater Toronto, Canada, Israel and around the world. UJA advances this mission through fundraising, programs, and research focused on our strategic pillars: fighting poverty and improving well-being, growing Jewish education and identity, countering antisemitism and hate, and strengthening connections with Israel and Jewish communities worldwide.
About the Opportunity

The team is looking to amplify and strengthen our fundraising strategy. As part of this initiative, we are hiring an Associate Director, Data Analytics & Prospecting
to own UJA's donor intelligence ecosystem — driving the data strategy, prospecting vision, and analytical frameworks that equip leadership, frontline fundraisers and operational teams with the intelligence they need to deepen cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, and campaign performance across the organization. Reporting to the Senior Director of Data, Analytics and Reporting, this role serves as the operational lead to the Senior Director within the function and acts as delegate to the Senior Director when needed.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic Leadership & Organizational Influence
Own and evolve UJA's end-to-end donor intelligence ecosystem, encompassing analytics strategy, prospect identification, data governance, and performance measurement.
Serve as a strategic operational lead alongside the Senior Director, driving the vision and roadmap for how data and prospecting power UJA's fundraising goals.
Act as delegate to the Senior Director in their absence, representing the function to senior leadership and ensuring continuity of strategic priorities.
Drive organization-wide decisions by translating donor intelligence into fundraising strategy — influencing campaign planning, gift officer deployment, portfolio design, and solicitation priorities.
Present insights, strategic recommendations, and performance reporting to executive leadership, and key stakeholders across the organization.
Champion a data-driven culture across the Integrated Development division, shaping how teams think about and use donor intelligence in their work.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Impact
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of two direct reports, fostering analytical excellence, professional growth, and high performance.
Spearhead cross-functional initiatives with Research, IT/Salesforce, Marketing, and frontline fundraising teams to embed analytics and prospecting insights into day-to-day operations.
Build and strengthen collaborative partnerships with senior fundraisers and division leaders, serving as a trusted advisor on donor strategy, capacity analysis, and prospect prioritization.
Establish and continuously improve standards, workflows, and best practices that scale the function's impact across the organization.

Donor Analytics & Performance Accountability
Design and own predictive models, donor scoring methodologies, and segmentation strategies that directly contribute to pipeline growth, major gift acquisition, and campaign performance targets.
Develop and maintain executive-level dashboards and reporting that connect analytics outputs to fundraising outcomes — tracking prospect conversion, portfolio health, upgrade rates, and campaign progress.
Deliver strategic portfolio and capacity analysis that equips operational teams with the intelligence they need to optimize fundraiser assignments, close capacity gaps, and act on high-potential upgrade and re-engagement opportunities.
Establish the KPIs and success metrics that hold the donor intelligence function accountable to fundraising impact, and ensure the resulting data sets are delivered to the operations team to inform execution and performance tracking
Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to deepen donor intelligence capabilities and accelerate prospecting at scale.
Establish and enforce data quality standards and governance practices to ensure accuracy and integrity across all systems and outputs.

Prospect Strategy & Pipeline Development
Set the strategic direction for prospect research and identification, ensuring the function proactively feeds the major gifts and campaign pipeline with qualified, high-value prospects.
Oversee the delivery of timely, high-quality research profiles, briefings, and due diligence that enable senior fundraisers to engage with confidence.
Drive innovation in prospect identification through wealth screening, data mining, predictive analytics, and community network analysis.
Develop and refine prospecting policies, processes, and frameworks that support the Integrated Development division's growth objectives.

Qualifications:

Relevant education or equivalent experience.
7+ years of progressive experience in fundraising analytics, prospect research, data strategy, or nonprofit development, with increasing strategic leadership responsibility.
3+ years of experience managing, mentoring, and developing staff, with demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence beyond direct reports.
Passionate advocate and visible champion of UJA’s mission, values, and goals, inspiring others through action and unwavering commitment to advancing our shared purpose.
Proven track record of driving fundraising outcomes through data — not just delivering reports, but shaping strategy and influencing organizational decisions.
Deep expertise in predictive modeling, donor scoring, portfolio segmentation, and performance measurement frameworks.
Proficient with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and experienced working with large, complex datasets.
Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies, with a track record of implementing tools that drive efficiency and strategic advantage.
Executive-level communication and presentation skills, with comfort presenting to senior leadership, and key stakeholders across the organization.
Familiarity with donor intelligence and wealth screening platforms such as iWave or similar tools.
Actively engaged in, and/or familiar with groups, networks, or organizations in the Jewish community, with the ability to engage, build relationships, and surface potential new donor prospects.
Strong project management skills with the ability to balance strategic priorities and operational demands.
Maintains a high degree of discretion, confidentiality, and respect for donor privacy.

This is a full-time permanent position, Salary Range: $89,000-99,000 annually, based on experience.

At UJA we support a flexible work schedule and all of our employees engage in hybrid work. Engagement and connection are key to supporting the best employee experience and we want to ensure that this puts balance and well-being at the forefront of our approach to ways of working. In addition to a rich time-off policy, UJA’s offices are closed on all Jewish holy days (yom tov) and we support early office closures to observe the Jewish Sabbath (Shabbat).
Qualified applicants are invited to submit a cover letter and resume.
Only those applicants invited for interview will be contacted. Please be advised that all offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of professional references and background checks including Social Media Account(s) and a Police Records Check/Vulnerable Sector Screening.
Commitment to Inclusion and Accessibility:

UJA Federation supports a diverse candidate and employment experience. We are proud of our dynamic professional team, which reflects the diversity of the Jewish community and general community alike in Greater Toronto. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all communities. We encourage you to follow us to get regular updates on open roles. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and believe this is essential to ensure that every member of our team can thrive.
We adhere to barrier-free and accessible employment practices in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). Should you require Code-protected accommodation through any stage of the recruitment process, please notify us and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Director of GTM Data, Processes, and AI Enablement
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform
for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers
, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining
Autodesk Operations Solutions
, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.
Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Role

MaintainX (part of Autodesk) is hiring a Director of GTM Data, Processes, and AI Enablement to own critical foundations of our GTM teams, including:

Customer and prospect data within our CRM;
Core CRM processes that enable selling across GTM teams (e.g., opportunity workflows, territory assignment processes); and
Our internal GenAI and automation efforts driving efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity of our GTM teams

This role also owns the integration of the MaintainX GTM teams into Autodesk GTM systems, processes, and GTM motions, for the core functional areas of the role – a key area of focus for the next 6 to 18 months.

The role sits in the broader MaintainX Revenue Strategy and Operations team and leads a small team of data quality analysts, but we expect this role to drive the majority of its impact through others outside of their direct team. Across all functional areas, this role will be working with, influencing, and directing the work of senior stakeholders, front-line managers, and ICs across Marketing, Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM Engineering. We need someone with deep functional expertise that knows best practices and has rapid pattern recognition for solutions to GTM issues, who is technical enough to be credible with engineers, and is practical enough to be trusted by sellers to get work done.

What You'll Do

Own CRM data quality and governance

Set the strategy, standards, and governance for leads, contacts, accounts, and account hierarchies. That includes parent/child structures, holding companies, franchises, PE portfolios, and multi-site customers.
Move data quality from cleanup to prevention. Put in intake controls, matching and dedupe rules, and enrichment precedence, and track them on a data quality scorecard with targets.
Show leadership what data gaps cost in revenue, and make GTM data ready for AI use cases.
Lead the team doing this work, including writing requirements for GTM Systems to implement.
Develop deduplication strategies and processes to manage a dual CRM environment across MaintainX and Autodesk

Drive core CRM-based processes and workflows

Own CRM territory management developing the processes and systems requirements to implement the territory design and strategy defined by GTM leadership and Rev Ops teams.
Own our rules of engagement: account ownership, crediting, and conflict resolution across segments, regions, and teams – including both MaintainX selling in isolation and coordination between MaintainX and Autodesk sellers
Own optimization of CRM processes and workflows for end user teams, including building an understanding of current processes, identifying points of improvement, working with GTM systems and Rev Ops teams to define business requirements
Collaborate with Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM systems teams to ensure field teams know how to use our systems and processes as they change, through release communications, training, and documentation.

Lead the GTM AI program for field teams

Run out GenAI and automation program for GTM field teams end to end: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across GTM and Engineering, operating cadences, solution evaluation, executive readouts, field enablement.
Lead discovery with Sales leaders to find the highest-value automation and agent opportunities. Align leadership and our GTM engineering team on one prioritized roadmap.
Own business requirements, build-vs-buy recommendations, and testing for centrally built solutions. Partner with Engineering to build and launch them.
Set the standards for how teams build their own solutions: knowledge base governance, a quality bar, and a path for scaling proven team-built tools across the org.
Own rollout with Enablement and measure adoption and ROI. The measure is workflows changed, not trainings delivered.

Lead integration efforts for MaintainX GTM into Autodesk

Own the GTM integration plan, governance and coordination across the workstreams, including: systems and data, account mapping and ownership, territories, sales process alignment, rules of engagement for joint selling, and enablement.
Coordinate stakeholders across both organizations. Run the cadence, track risks and dependencies, and escalate decisions.
Be accountable for integration outcomes, not just coordination.

About You

10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM strategy at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years leading people.
Deep expertise in core sales processes, territory design, and rules of engagement.
Strong command of the CRM data model: Salesforce objects, account hierarchies, matching, and enrichment. You define and specify; you don't need to configure.
Hands-on experience bringing AI into GTM workflows (LLMs, agents, workflow automation), with results you can measure. Fluent enough to work credibly with engineers.
A track record of leading large cross-functional programs through influence, including with VP and C-level leaders.
M&A or GTM integration experience is strongly preferred.
Clear writing and speaking. You can make complex tradeoffs understandable to sellers, engineers, and executives.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits.
Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging.
We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

jobs.title: Director, Deal Desk & Pricing Strategy
jobs.description:
At Varicent, We’re Not Just Transforming The Sales Performance Management (SPM) Market—we’re Redefining How Organizations Achieve Revenue Success. Our Cutting-edge SaaS Solutions Empower Revenue Leaders Globally To Design Smarter Go-to-market Strategies, Maximize Seller Performance, And Unlock Untapped Potential. Varicent Stands At The Forefront Of Innovation, Celebrated As a Market Leader In The 2025 Forrester Wave Report For SPM, 2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index, Gartner Peer Insights, 2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide, And G2. Our Solutions Are Trusted By a Diverse Range Of Global Industry Leaders Like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker And Hundreds More. Here’s Why You’ll Thrive At Varicent

Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.
Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.
Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.
Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

Summary Of The Role And Team

As Director of Deal Desk & Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote-to-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.
Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.
Own quote-to-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.
Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.
Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.
Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.
Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.
Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.

What You Bring

Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12+ years)
Experience leading teams, programs, or cross-functional operational functions (typically 5+ years)
Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell transactions
Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote-to-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design
Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms
Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions
Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations

Success Outcomes

First 90 Days

Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote-to-booking workflows.
Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.

Within 6 Months

Roll out clear governance frameworks, approval structures, and operational standards across the Deal Desk function.
Raise quote quality, pricing accuracy, and first-pass approval rates while cutting rework and processing delays.
Set up consistent forecasting workflows with Finance using Deal Desk insights and commercial data.
Strengthen data integrity and alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related systems.
Develop scalable team operating rhythms and performance metrics aligned to business objectives.

Within 12 Months

Position Deal Desk as a go-to strategic partner across Go-To-Market, Finance, and Executive teams.
Show measurable gains in deal cycle times, pricing governance, compliance, and forecasting accuracy.
Deliver scalable quote-to-booking processes that support growth while maintaining strong controls and audit readiness.
Build a high-performing Deal Desk organization with clear accountability and operational excellence.
Create a sustainable operating model that supports revenue growth, profitability objectives, and commercial scalability.

This posting is for a existing
vacancy.

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement — not replace — human decision-making.

Overview Of Benefits

Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage tailored to your local needs
Time Off — PTO and public holidays to rest, recharge, and do what matters most
Volunteer Days — Dedicated time to give back and support the communities that matter to you
Ignite Days — Dedicated learning days to support continuous growth, skill development, and professional learning
Financial — Compensation that reflects your market and your value
Retirement — Retirement plans designed to help you build long-term financial security
Tuition Assistance — Invest in your growth with support for continuing education and professional development
Flexibility — Work where you thrive, with remote and hybrid options available across most regions

Varicent is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process please email accomodations@varicent.com

Varicent is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. Clearsulting stands by its culture, shaped by our five Core Values: GRIT, Growth Mindset, Joy, Accountability, and Teamwork. Role

Consulting Director, Financial Reporting (Workiva)

Location:

Exceptional consulting, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to influence executive audiences.
Experience supporting business development efforts, including proposals, solution demonstrations, estimating, and client pursuits.

Experience mentoring consultants and developing high-performing delivery teams.

Experience in external reporting or controllership functions within a public company.
Experience with Workiva Wdata, Chains, SQL, and platform integrations.
Experience integrating Workiva with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or Workday.

Cell phone reimbursement

jobs.title: Director, Clinical Data Management
jobs.description:
Everest Clinical Research (“Everest”) is a full-service contract research organization (CRO) providing a broad range of expertise-based clinical research services to worldwide pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. We serve some of the best-known companies and work with many of the most advanced drugs, biologics, and medical devices in development today.

Everest has been an independent CRO since 2004 with a strong foundation as a statistical and data management center of excellence. Building on this foundation, Everest has successfully developed and established itself as a full-service CRO. Everest’s Corporate headquarters are located in Ontario, Canada and US headquarters in New Jersey, USA, with additional physical offices in Asia and Europe.

Everest is known in the industry for its high-quality deliverables, superior customer service, and flexibility in meeting clients’ needs. A dynamic organization with an entrepreneurial origin, Everest continues to experience exceptional growth and great success.

Quality is our backbone, customer-focus is our tradition, flexibility is our strength…that’s us…that’s Everest.

To drive continued success in this exciting clinical research field, we are seeking committed, skilled, and customer-focused individuals to join our winning team as Director, Clinical Data Management
for our Toronto/Markham, Ontario, Canada on-site location, or remotely from a home-based office anywhere in Canada in accordance with our Work from Home policy.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Establish and control clinical data operations to provide complete, valid, safe, and secure databases which meet corporate and regulatory clinical data requirements.

Develop and manage clinical data management budget and resource plans and perform ongoing assessment and control for the utilization of resources and budget. Achieve divisional objectives within the agreed upon budget.

Manage client project portfolios in conjunction with other corporate executives. Maintain strong client relations. Assist in the development of project bids for new projects.

Ensure timely availability of the clinical data capture instruments and databases, and contribute to their completeness, validity, and effectiveness for use in product development, local registration, and support by planning and directing the integration of clinical CRF design, database definition, database administration, data entry, data management, storage, and QC and QA.

Integrate the operations of Clinical Data Management with the requirements of the Quality Assurance and Compliance, Project Management, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, and Medical Writing functional areas to assure cooperative realization of corporate objectives and to optimize the productivity and effectiveness of clinical data management.

Perform competitive bench marking of clinical data operations to ensure that data management techniques and procedures used are the best in the class.

Plan, direct, and follow up on the establishment of data management guidelines and procedures which are in line with industry good data management practices.

Participate and contribute to the corporate efforts, in investigating, establishing, and implementing new and advanced systems, standards, and procedures to improve the effectiveness of data capture and management.

Recruit, train, motivate, and develop staff to ensure high levels of performance with strong professional and technical expertise. Complete annual and semi‑annual performance reviews. Plan, implement, and oversee staff training and development process.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management – Developer & AI
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The Senior Director of Product Management for Developer & AI will lead product strategy and execution across one of 1Password’s most future-defining portfolios. This role spans our Developer Experience (DevX) products, Security for AI, and AI for Security initiatives, as well as the product surface area that supports standards adoption and developer engagement.

Reporting to the VP of Developer & AI Engineering, this leader will be responsible for defining the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes for how developers and AI-powered systems securely interact with 1Password—from local development and secrets management, to programmatic agent access, to secure runtime environments.

This role requires deep partnership with engineering, design, marketing, partnerships, and GTM teams, and leadership of a senior group of product managers operating across highly technical, platform-oriented problem spaces.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading senior PMs or product portfolios.
Experience owning platform, developer-facing, or infrastructure products strongly preferred.
Track record of shipping impactful developer tools, platforms, or security products used by large or fast-growing audiences.
Strong familiarity with the modern AI landscape, including LLMs, orchestration frameworks, and agentic workflows.
Ability to reason about AI capabilities and limitations through a product and customer lens.
Solid understanding of modern security concepts such as identity, secrets management, access control, and secure system design.
Comfort operating in highly technical problem spaces alongside senior engineers.
Ability to connect long-term product vision with near-term priorities and measurable outcomes.
Experience balancing discovery, delivery, and platform investment.
Demonstrated success partnering deeply with engineering, design, marketing, and external stakeholders.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence without authority.

What You Can Expect

Set and evolve the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for 1Password’s Developer Experience, AI security, and AI-powered security initiatives.
Ensure clear articulation of customer problems, value propositions, and success metrics across the portfolio.
Lead product definition for secure, agentic workflows including identity, delegation, secrets delivery, and access control for both developers and AI agents.
Translate emerging AI capabilities and risks into durable, differentiated product primitives.
Work in lockstep with the VP of Developer & AI Engineering to align product strategy with technical vision, architecture, and delivery.
Enable strong product-engineering collaboration that balances innovation, speed, and long-term platform integrity.
Partner with Marketing, Partnerships, Security, and GTM teams to ensure successful launches, platform integrations, and ecosystem adoption.
Represent product strategy internally and externally, ensuring consistency across messaging, documentation, and developer engagement.
Provide product leadership and input into standards participation and developer advocacy efforts, ensuring standards work is grounded in real customer needs and product direction.
Help position 1Password as a trusted product leader in the AI and security ecosystem.
Recruit, mentor, and lead senior product managers working across complex, technical domains.
Establish product operating rhythms, decision-making frameworks, and outcome-oriented metrics.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $267,000 USD and $401,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $248,000 CAD and $372,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Financial Officer

Hamilton, Ontario

The Role

Lancaster Group is a growing multi-trade construction company is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to provide strong financial leadership, strengthen financial controls and reporting, and support the continued growth of the organization.
Reporting directly to the President and ownership group, the CFO will be a key member of the senior leadership team, acting as a trusted financial partner to the President and the business.
This role requires more than strong technical financial expertise. We are seeking a confident, hands-on leader who can manage and develop a finance team, work effectively with ownership, managers and operational teams, and translate complex financial information into clear, practical business direction.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in a multi-trade, unionized construction environment and understand the financial complexities associated with project-based work, multiple trades, collective agreements, labour costing, job costing, and project profitability.
The organization is currently transitioning from Sage 300 Construction and Real Estate (Timberline) to Maestro ERP. The CFO will play an important role in supporting the financial side of this transition and ensuring strong financial processes, controls, reporting and data integrity within the new system. The CFO will also follow through with a new structured bonus plan initiative and set budgets within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership and Strategy

Lead the company's overall financial strategy, planning and reporting
Act as a trusted financial advisor to ownership and senior leadership
Provide timely, accurate financial information and analysis to support business decisions
Clearly communicate financial performance, risks, trends and opportunities
Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning
Provide financial guidance to support strategic decisions and continued growth
Develop and monitor financial KPIs, dashboards and management reporting
Identify financial concerns proactively and bring forward practical recommendations and solutions

Financial Reporting and Controls

Oversee monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial statements and management reporting
Establish and maintain strong financial controls, policies and procedures
Oversee cash flow, working capital, banking and treasury functions
Strengthen cost controls and financial accountability across the organization
Manage relationships with external accountants, financial institutions, insurers and other financial partners
Ensure compliance with applicable accounting, tax and regulatory requirements

Construction and Project Financial Management

Oversee project financial reporting, job costing, WIP and profitability analysis
Monitor project margins, costs, commitments and overall financial performance
Oversee progress billing and other construction-related financial processes
Work collaboratively with project managers and operational leaders to strengthen forecasting, cost control and financial accountability
Ensure accurate and timely job costing and financial reporting across projects
Analyze project performance and identify financial risks, cost overruns and margin opportunities
Improve visibility into project performance and overall company profitability

Multi Trade and Union Financial Management

Understand the financial complexities of operating across multiple construction trades
Understand labour costing, labour burden, union-related costs and their impact on project profitability
Support accurate costing and financial administration in an environment involving multiple collective agreements and labour structures
Work effectively with finance, project management and operations to ensure labour costs are appropriately captured, allocated and reported
Understand how varying trade and labour requirements affect estimating, forecasting, job costing and project financial performance

ERP and Process Improvement

Provide financial leadership during the transition from Sage 300 to Maestro ERP
Ensure appropriate financial controls, processes and reporting are established within the ERP
Support data integrity and accurate financial reporting throughout the transition
Identify opportunities to streamline financial workflows and improve reporting
Work collaboratively with internal teams to support successful ERP adoption
Establish scalable financial processes and systems that support continued company growth

Leadership and Team Development

Provide strong, visible leadership to the finance and accounting team
Lead, mentor, coach and develop team members
Establish clear expectations and hold the finance team accountable for results
Build a strong, capable and accountable finance function
Communicate expectations, priorities and financial information clearly and effectively
Build strong working relationships with ownership, senior leadership, project managers, operations and employees across the organization
Address issues directly and constructively and drive matters through to resolution
Foster a collaborative, professional and results-focused environment
Lead by example and promote accountability, accuracy and continuous improvement

The Ideal Candidate

As the ideal candidate, you are an experienced and visionary leader with strategic thinking and strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization. This includes the ability to explain complex financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders and a proven ability to lead, develop and hold teams accountable. Preferably, you bring significant senior financial leadership experience at the CFO, VP Finance or senior Controller level in a multi-trade construction environment, having worked within a unionized construction environment and through multiple collective agreements.

Qualifications and Required Experience:

We recognize that no one candidate is likely to meet all qualifications in equal measure. Those listed below are desirable and will be used to compare candidates.
CPA designation is required
Minimum 5 years of progressive financial leadership experience within construction or a closely related project-based industry
Minimum 4 years of progressive financial leadership experience within multi-trade construction environments
Minimum 3 years of unionized construction environment experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in job costing, WIP, project margins, and construction accounting
Construction operational skills and COR recertification are assets
Strong knowledge of construction accounting, job costing, WIP, labour costing, project margins, progress billing, cash flow and forecasting
Demonstrated ability to understand project financial performance and work effectively with project and operational teams
Demonstrated experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and internal controls
Experience with ERP implementation, conversion or significant system improvement
Experience with Sage 300 Construction and Real Estate (Timberline) and/or Maestro ERP is an asset
Confident and comfortable challenging assumptions, raising concerns and providing practical financial recommendations
Comfortable working in a growing, hands-on and fast-paced construction environment

You are someone with:

The ability to build and lead a high-performing team and engage with internal and external stakeholders to achieve goals and outcomes
The ability to effectively explain decisions and bring clarity to complex issues to a variety of audiences, including boards
A high capacity to balance multiple priorities while being responsive, including maintaining ROCE and all government grants and incentives
A growth-oriented mindset, both organic and acquisition
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

Salary and Benefits

Salary: From CAD $200,000.00 annually

The successful candidate will receive extended health care, paid time off, access to engaging company events, and on-site parking.

Apply Now

If you are interested in this opportunity, contact Mark Gillis, Partner, at mgillis@kbrs.ca, or Ben Broadbent, Recruitment Specialist, at bbroadbent@kbrs.ca or submit your full application package online by clicking “Apply Now”.
